en.headline: EMSD orders all lift contractors to review 10 years of landing door works
en.dek: Contractors must confirm fire-resisting performance of landing doors and frames fitted between October 2017 and October 2026 and file declarations by 15 November.
body: The Electrical and Mechanical Services Department has issued a special circular to all registered lift contractors and engineers requiring a full review of lift landing doors and associated frame components installed or replaced over the past ten years.

The review covers works submitted on Form LE7 between 17 October 2017 and 16 October 2026. Contractors must submit a Lift Landing Door Fire Performance Declaration by 15 November confirming that doors and frames meet design and fire-resistance specifications. False statements are an offence.

The move follows the discovery that Taizoom Elevator (Hong Kong) Limited fitted fire-resistant doors but omitted the matching frame components on 48 lifts at Tsui Ping North Estate and Pok Hong Estate. The department said the new process is intended to strengthen assurance of landing-door systems across the industry.

zh.headline: 機電署要求全港升降機承辦商審視十年來層站門抗火效能
zh.dek: 承辦商須於11月15日前交回聲明書，確認2017年10月至2026年10月期間更換或增設的層站門及門框符合耐火規格。
body: 機電工程署向全港註冊升降機承辦商及註冊升降機工程師發出特別通告，要求全面審視過去十年涉及更換或增設層站門的所有升降機。
審視範圍涵蓋2017年10月17日至2026年10月16日期間提交「表格LE7」的工程。承辦商須於今年11月15日或之前交回「升降機層站門抗火效能證明聲明書」，確認門結構及門框組件符合設計及耐火規格，虛假聲明屬違法。
署方指，此舉是在發現臺日電梯（香港）有限公司於翠屏北邨及博康邨共48部升降機只安裝耐火門、漏裝門框組件後推出，目的是加強對層站門系統安裝及運作的保障。
